verdict.rationale:
ACP is published as an open-source, Apache-2.0 spec that any business/PSP can implement, and MPP ships an explicit conformance CLI (`mppx validate`) that tests discovery, challenge formats, error handling, and full payment flow — real validation tooling for at least one protocol. However, there's no evidence of explicit protocol versioning, no discoverable machine-readable schema (OpenAPI probe returned 404s), and community feedback flags the SPT/MPP docs as 'sparse' on how objects and end-to-end flows actually work, undercutting the completeness of the published schema story.
missing for 10: explicit protocol version numbers/changelog, a published machine-readable schema (OpenAPI/JSON schema) for ACP/UCP, conformance tooling covering ACP/UCP (not just MPP), independent corroboration that validation tooling works as documented.
